title: Healthcare Shared Clinical Device Management — WOWs, Kiosks & Tablets in Microsoft Intune
author_notes: Derived from a Senior Endpoint Engineer (healthcare/Epic) requirement: support the Epic device ecosystem (WOWs, kiosks, tablets, workstations) and standardize shared clinical devices.

Scope: provision + standardize + lock down shared clinical Windows devices (WOWs, kiosks, nurse-station PCs, tablets) via Microsoft Intune — Autopilot self-deploying, Shared PC mode, Assigned Access kiosk, clinical app baseline, WOW always-on. No personal-owner affinity. Epic/Imprivata depth deferred to their dedicated solutions. White-label.
pricing: T3 (advanced) — multi-component shared-device standardization within one platform.
